title.narrative: UNICEF Pakistan completed a data assessment, developed a data action plan, and launched a data fluency initiative. Efforts to build an integrated data system began, alongside risk-based monitoring for better programme effectiveness. Additionally, UNICEF facilitated 34 new partnerships with CSOs to strengthen programme implementation.
